HttpAlignment.description:
HTTP alignment object for `/with-timestamps` endpoints.

Times are in **seconds** (f64).

characterEndTimesSeconds.description: End time for each character in seconds.

characterStartTimesSeconds.description: Start time for each character in seconds.

FineTuningModel.description:
Fine-tuning model for PVC voices.

Note: The `state` field is a map from model ID to fine-tuning state,
as each voice can have different fine-tuning status per model.

is_allowed_to_fine_tune.description: Whether fine-tuning is allowed for this voice.

next_max_verification_attempts_reset_uni.description: Unix timestamp for next verification reset.

state.description: Fine-tuning state per model. Keys are model IDs like "eleven_multilingual_v2".

LanguageModel.description:
Language model for voices.

Used in verified_languages array. The API can return different field
combinations depending on context.

language_id.description:
Language identifier (e.g., "en").
Note: API returns this as "language" in verified_languages.

model_id.description: Model ID this language is verified for.

name.description:
Display name (e.g., "English").
May not be present in all API responses.

preview_url.description: URL to preview audio for this language.

available_for_tiers.description: Subscription tiers this voice is available for.

collection_ids.description: Collection IDs this voice belongs to.

created_at_unix.description: Unix timestamp when the voice was created.

favorited_at_unix.description: Unix timestamp when the voice was favorited.

high_quality_base_model_ids.description: Base model IDs that support high-quality for this voice.

is_legacy.description: Whether this is a legacy voice.

is_mixed.description: Whether this voice uses mixed models.

is_owner.description: Whether the current user owns this voice.

preview_url.description: URL to preview audio for this voice.

safety_control.description: Safety control level for this voice.
